div.head: Northu 10.1
div.ab: ⁊ gif hæþen cild binnon IX nihton þurh gimeliste forfaren sy, betan for Gode buton worldwite; ⁊ gif hit ofer nigan niht gewurðe, betan for Gode, ⁊ gilde XII ór for ðare heorde, þe he wæs hæþen swa lange.

And gif hæþen cild binnon IX nihton þurh gimeliste forfaren sy, betan for Gode buton worldwite; and gif hit ofer nigan niht gewurðe, betan for Gode and gilde XII or for ðare heorde, þe he wæs hæþen swa lange.

Und wenn ein durch Nachlässigkeit ungetauftes Kind innerhalb 9 Tagen gestorben ist, so mögen sie [die Eltern nur] geistlich büssen, ohne materielles Strafgeld; wenn das [Sterben] jedoch nach 9 Tagen geschieht, sollen sie geistlich büssen, und er [der Vormund] zahle 12 Ör für die Obhut[sverletzung], dass es so lange ungetauft gewesen ist.

And if a child unbaptised through negligence has died within 9 days, let them [the parents] atone [only] spiritually, without a secular fine; but if [the death] happens after 9 days, let them atone spiritually, and let him [the guardian] pay 12 ores for the [breach of] care, that it was unbaptised so long.

And if a child dies heathen within nine days, through carelessness, amends are to be made to God, without a secular fine; and if it occur after nine days, amends are to be made to God, and 12 ores to be paid for the [lack of] care, that it remained heathen so long.

And if a child dies a heathen within nine nights out of neglect, penance is to be done before God without a secular penalty; and if it occurs after nine nights, penance is to be done before God and twelve oras are to be paid for that neglect, because the child remained a heathen for so long.
div.note: U: checked against Whitelock, EHD I (1979), and corrected (before: ‘If if a child dies a heathen within nine days, through carelessness, amends are to be made to God, without a secular fine; and if it occur after nine days, amends are to be made to God, and 12 ores to be paid for the [lack of] care, that it remained heathen so long.’).

Nicht der Priester kann gemeint sein, dessen Taufweigerung schon o. c. 8 ebenso hoch strafte, auch ohne dass das Kind ohne Taufe starb, was doch gewiss den Fall erschwerte.—Vgl. Gl Strafgeldfixum 7a. In Satz 1 liegt nur Halbverletzung (s. d. Gl) vor

The priest cannot be meant, since his refusal to baptize was already punished just as heavily above c. 8, even without the child dying unbaptized, which would surely have aggravated the case. — Cf. Gl Strafgeldfixum 7a. Sentence 1 involves only a half-breach (see that word in Gl)

Nicht ‘Härte’. Ein solches Fem. fehlt Agsächsisch; auch müsste eo Schreibfehler sein. Wie mund neben ‘Schutz’ auch ‘Schutzbruch’, so wird heord, sonst ‘custodia, cura’, hier deren Verletzung bezeichnen

Not ‘harshness’. Such a feminine is lacking in Anglo-Saxon; moreover eo would have to be a scribal error. Just as mund denotes not only ‘protection’ but also ‘breach of protection’, so heord, elsewhere ‘custodia, cura’, will here denote the violation of these
